title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.54
summary: Player choices for shows and episodes, with opaque settings surfaces and consistent native menus.

sections.heading: Choose how to play a show
bullets: Play using on a show or season opens the episode browser first. Choose an episode to use the existing playback choices.
Episode cards continue to open the chooser directly. Set default player in a TV context changes the episode default without starting playback.

sections.heading: Clearer settings and native menus
bullets: Settings use an opaque BlackLanturn background across Kodi's content area.
Deeper settings and selection screens use the shared menu styling. Playback settings and stream controls keep their compact layout.

sections.heading: Keep your settings and sign-ins
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn for the installed edition to retain saved preferences, accounts, history and unrelated add-ons.
Installer1.0.49 remains current. No installer upgrade is needed when it is already installed. Both editions retain their existing compatible add-ons and platform playback differences.
